desc: 细刷头取料易控制，雾泥质地成膜，唇颊两用，全部色号由强调色占位承载
leaf: 雾面泥感唇颊两用刷头唇釉
name: 唇颊两用轻雾泥感刷头唇釉款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用开盖立管、抽出的绒毛刷杆与身后一片抹开的雾面泥色块同时交代器形与哑光质地
承接主图，用满幅斜向泥状色带加五组编号位一秒交代主张结构，主张文字全部留占位
shots.textZone: 右侧五条编号短句位「{selling_point_1}」至「{selling_point_5}」，顶部一条空白标题带「{callout_1}」

shots.intent: 把泥状成膜的哑光妆效直接放大成版面主体，让买家代入上唇后的真实质感
shots.textZone: 顶部大标题位「{selling_point_4}」，底部两行小字说明位「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 用同机位双栏叠涂对比说明取料可薄可厚的可控度，两侧主张一律留空
shots.textZone: 中缝一枚空白圆角标签位「{callout_3}」，两栏下方各一条空白标签位

shots.intent: 用方格微距质地墙证明泥状配方的粉雾颗粒与拖尾边缘，回答质地疑虑
把源图三页同版式选色宫格收成一镜，让买家在统一妆效下自行比对可选色域
shots.textZone: 顶部标题带一格「{selling_point_2}」，九格下方各一枚空白圆角标签位

shots.intent: 在肤底上给出第二套选色读法，用未印色块排让买家按深浅自行定位
收口前交代到手内容物与器形组件，全部凭证位留成空白框由买家自行填入

style.backgroundSystem: seamless cool porcelain white #FFFFFF for packshots, texture walls and swatch charts, alternating with lotus-ash matte panels #E7DCE0 and one deep plum-ash field #4A3A45; the cool rose hairline #C25C77 is only ever a rule line, never a lip or swatch hue, because every shade value is carried by the accent placeholder
style.direction: cool porcelain matte mud-finish lip colour commerce
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight hairline rules and blank rounded label pills outlined in cool rose #C25C77, oversized translucent numerals for the numbered claim list, no filled illustrative icons and no tick, cross or arrow graphics
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key cool studio light, front-left softbox key with a fill card, butterfly light on skin crops, skimming sweep across matte swatch ridges, soft contact shadows only, never a wet specular on a velvet finish
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool porcelain matte lip colour visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless cool porcelain white #FFFFFF, lotus-ash #E7DCE0, deep plum-ash #4A3A45 and one cool rose hairline accent #C25C77, with every lip and swatch hue carried by one accent placeholder; bright even high-key cool studio lighting with a front-left softbox key and fill card, butterfly light on skin crops, skimming sweep across matte swatch ridges, soft contact shadows and no wet speculars; modern geometric sans-serif typography only; thin single-weight hairline rules, oversized translucent numerals and blank rounded label pills; stable open-tube-with-applicator anchor angle and scale with powdery feathered swipe edges; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no fixed lip shade hue across the set
no glossy finish on a matte product
style.presentationRules: one open-tube-with-flocked-applicator anchor reused at stable scale, formula always rendered as powdery velvet with feathered swipe edges, every skin crop taken at the nose so no identity shows, and every lip or swatch hue carried by the accent placeholder instead of a fixed shade
style.surfaceSystem: seamless cool white sweep plus lotus-ash matte boards #E7DCE0 laid flat for overhead work and one deep plum-ash board #4A3A45 under the grid walls, no horizon and no table edge visible
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif only: one oversized headline, one thin numeral column and small label lines, all in-image copy supplied at generation time as placeholders
